dateRange.description: Only return posts published inside this window. LinkedIn Top Content is a curated archive, so 24h/7d/30d windows are often empty.
dateRange.title: Date Range

includeComments.description: Attach the public comments embedded on each post page (up to maxComments).
includeComments.title: Include Top Comments

includeVideoTranscript.description: Add the transcript when a public video post publishes one.
includeVideoTranscript.title: Include Video Transcript

maxComments.description: Comments to keep per post. Public post pages embed about 10.
maxComments.title: Max Comments per Post

maxDepth.description: How deep to crawl each selected topic. 2 = the topic page only (~10 posts); 3 = topic + its 20 subtopics; 4 = subtopics + their leaves (very large; use maxPosts). (mode=topContent/auto)
maxDepth.title: Topic Depth

maxPosts.description: Maximum posts to deliver after deduplication, filtering and sorting. Depth 2 across one topic usually has fewer than 10 unique posts; deeper crawls have more.
maxPosts.title: Max Posts

maxVoices.description: Maximum Top Voices honorees to return after deduplication. (mode=topVoices)
maxVoices.title: Max Honorees

mediaTypeFilter.description: Only return posts of one media type. Public Top Content pages contain text, image, video and article posts.
mediaTypeFilter.title: Media Type Filter

minComments.description: Only return posts with at least this many comments.
minComments.title: Minimum Comments

minReactions.description: Only return posts with at least this many reactions.
minReactions.title: Minimum Reactions

mode.description: What to scrape. 'Top Content directory' crawls LinkedIn's public curated topic pages; 'Top Voices class' reads a quarterly LinkedIn News honoree list; 'Post URLs' enriches specific public posts.
mode.title: Mode

onlyInfluencers.description: Return only posts whose author carries LinkedIn's public 'Influencer' badge. This is not the same as a Top Voices class membership.
onlyInfluencers.title: Only Influencer-Badged Authors

postUrls.description: Public LinkedIn post URLs to enrich directly: /posts/..., /feed/update/urn:li:activity|share|ugcPost:..., or country subdomains. (mode=postUrls/auto)
postUrls.title: Post URLs

postedAfter.description: Only return posts published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
postedAfter.title: Posted After

postedBefore.description: Only return posts published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
postedBefore.title: Posted Before

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy override. The actor works without a proxy; it only falls back to Apify's datacenter proxy if LinkedIn blocks the request.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

sortBy.description: Order of the delivered posts. 'LinkedIn rank' preserves each page's editorial order.
sortBy.title: Sort By

startUrls.description: Exact /top-content/... pages to scrape instead of expanding topics. Each page returns its ranked posts only. (mode=topContent/auto)
startUrls.title: Start URLs (exact Top Content pages)

topVoiceClassUrls.description: LinkedIn News Top Voices class articles (/pulse/...). Leave empty to use the latest US class. (mode=topVoices/auto)
topVoiceClassUrls.title: Top Voices Class URLs

topics.description: Pick one or more Top Content topics or subtopics, or paste any /top-content/... path or URL (custom values are accepted). Topic page = ~9-10 ranked posts; subtopics add ~20 more pages each. (mode=topContent/auto)
